content.text: Section 11 squarely delivers the preferred position, and Sections 9, 10, and 15 contain no conflicting deletion or withholding terms.

input.quote: 11.1 Upon expiry or termination for any reason, Vendor shall, at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six months at the rates in the expiring Order Form. Assistance includes knowledge transfer, export support, cooperation with a replacement supplier, orderly migration, and continued service at the then-current scope and service levels.
input.rationale: Section 11 meets or exceeds the preferred position on all three elements. (a) Transition assistance: 11.1 gives Customer up to six months of assistance on request, priced at the rates in the expiring Order Form — more favourable to us than the playbook's "then-current rates" — and expressly includes knowledge transfer, export support, cooperation with a replacement supplier, migration, and continued service at existing scope and service levels. (b) Data return: 11.2 requires return of all Customer Data within thirty days in a complete, commonly used, documented, machine-readable format with relationships and metadata, and bars Vendor from holding data hostage over a fee dispute. (c) Deletion and certification: 11.3 sequences deletion only after Customer confirms successful return, limits any retained copy to what Applicable Law requires (protected and use-restricted), and requires written certification by an authorized officer. Cross-checks show no conflict: Section 10.1 preserves Customer Data rights and ends access only after any agreed transition period; Section 15 restricts Vendor's processing; the definition of Customer Data (1.3) is broad; and no suspension, termination (Section 9), or other clause permits immediate deletion or withholding. No redline needed.
